title: Something on the Stove
description:
The **Cooking Pot** turns raw ingredients into meals. Set it on any heat source — campfire, stove, even a furnace — add ingredients, and wait.

Most recipes need a container. Keep bowls handy.

Meals are worth far more than their ingredients when sold. A beef stew beats selling the beef, the carrot and the potato separately — and meals made with meat and milk are worth more than vegetable ones.

This is the main way a farm turns into an income.
